Name: Accounting
Description: Manages financial records, reports, and compliance.

Name: Finance
Description: Handles budgeting, investments, and capital management.

Name: Human Resources
Description: Oversees recruitment, employee relations, and compensation.

Name: Information Technology
Description: Manages all technological infrastructure and support systems.

Name: Marketing
Description: Develops and executes promotional campaigns and brand strategy.

Name: Sales
Description: Drives revenue by managing customer acquisition and deals.

Name: Production
Description: Responsible for the manufacturing and assembly of products.

Name: Research & Development
Description: Innovates and designs new products or services.

Name: Legal
Description: Provides legal counsel and ensures regulatory compliance.

Name: Procurement
Description: Manages the acquisition of goods, services, and raw materials.

Name: Logistics
Description: Coordinates transportation, warehousing, and inventory flow.

Name: Quality Assurance
Description: Ensures products meet established quality standards and specifications.

Name: Customer Support
Description: Handles customer inquiries, issues, and technical assistance.

Name: Facilities
Description: Maintains physical office spaces and company properties.

Name: Communications
Description: Manages internal and external public relations and messaging.

Name: Security
Description: Protects company assets, data, and personnel.

Name: Training & Development
Description: Designs and delivers programs to enhance employee skills.

Name: Administration
Description: Provides organizational and clerical support to management.

Name: Corporate Governance
Description: Ensures adherence to internal policies and ethical standards.

Name: Sustainability
Description: Develops and manages environmental and social responsibility initiatives.
